department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
benefit: Help for artisans in 18 traditional trades (like carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, tailor, barber, mason). You get a certificate and ID card, skill training with Rs 500 a day stipend, a Rs 15,000 toolkit grant, and loans with no security: Rs 1 lakh first, then Rs 2 lakh, at 5% interest. You also get Re 1 per digital payment (up to 100 a month).

other: You must work with your hands and tools in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades, on your own (self-employed).
You must not have taken a similar government business loan (like PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or Mudra) in the past 5 years.
Only one person per family (husband, wife and unmarried children).
Government employees and their families cannot apply.

documents: Ration card (or Aadhaar of all family members if you have no ration card)
how_to_apply: Register on the PM Vishwakarma portal through your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). The CSC also helps you open a bank account if you have none.
where_to_apply: Nearest Common Service Centre (CSC); help also at MSME-DFO offices and District Industries Centres
